data.exact_reserve_text: The Ultimate Loss for the 2022 underwriting year has reduced from GBP 4,746,287 to GBP 4,394,733, reflecting conservative reserving releases, and both 2023 and 2024 underwriting years are forecast to produce Ultimate Profits of GBP 5,280,307 and GBP 13,216,917.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 8.228m in 2024 (a reduction in gross claims outstanding), representing a c.13.5% release versus opening gross claims reserves (GBP 60.867m). The movement is disclosed in the Technical Provisions note as a negative change in estimates of prior year provisions and is described in the Underwriter commentary as a reduction in the 2022 underwriting year ultimate loss, reflecting conservative reserving releases.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (8,228)

The Property class has material uncertainty within the gross claims provision. The ultimate liability on this class is heavily dependent on the outcome of claims relating to a small number of large losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development extracted from Note 5 'Technical provisions' line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the same note. The report also contains an underwriting commentary referencing a reduction in the 2022 ultimate loss which corroborates the release. A gross claims development table (triangle) is present in the report (values in GBP '000) and was cross-checked. No specific named catastrophe events affecting the prior-year movement were cited.
